_note: STYLE = Layer 2 (the LOOK). Curated word-only deck. A journey picks a style by NAME (its `style` field); the composer NEVER writes free-text style_suffix. `--style <name>` overrides at render time for A/B look-tests. Keep every entry SHINY / RENDERED / eye-candy — the DreamShaper-polished look Phil wants. NEVER use realism words here (photo, photograph, photography, macro, realistic, DSLR, film grain) — they drift the whole video photoreal. `model` is the RECOMMENDED checkpoint when the render doesn't pass --model.

_brand_tail_note: Appended to EVERY resolved style (Phil 2026-07-31: cave_of_numbers came out monochromatic orange/yellow — 'we want eye candy contrasting colours, sparkly gemstone shiny things'). Kept to LIGHT/SURFACE words, never object nouns: 'gemstone' as a noun would paint literal gems into meadows and kitchens (the 'rose dust' trap). Tune the whole catalog here.
